subproblem.title: Reduction to a plane with small tilt and small height
subproblem.statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^N (Lean Euclid N), Q : ℝ^N → {subspaces of ℝ^N} such that x ↦ p_{Q(x)} := (Q x).starProjection is μ-a.e. strongly measurable, ξ ∈ ℝ^N, σ > 0, a ≥ 0, M > 0, h₁ ∈ ℝ, and T, T₁ subspaces of ℝ^N. For a subspace S' write J(S') := ∫_{B_σ(ξ)} Σ_i |p_{Q(x)}e_i − p_{S'}e_i|² dμ(x), the lower Lebesgue integral of ENNReal.ofReal of the Hilbert–Schmidt sum (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1, B_σ(ξ) the closed ball). Assume μ(B_σ(ξ)) ≥ M, J(T₁) ≤ a, and |(x − ξ) − p_{T₁}(x − ξ)| ≤ h₁ for every x ∈ spt μ ∩ B_σ(ξ). Then there is a subspace S with S = T or S = T₁ such that J(S) ≤ a, J(S) ≤ J(T), and |(x − ξ) − p_S(x − ξ)| ≤ h₁ + (4a/M)^{1/2}σ for every x ∈ spt μ ∩ B_σ(ξ).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid N)) (Q : Euclid N → Submodule ℝ (Euclid N)) (ξ : Euclid N) (σ a M h₁ : ℝ) (T T₁ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N)), 0 < σ → 0 ≤ a → 0 < M → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) μ → ENNReal.ofReal M ≤ μ (closedBall ξ σ) → ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin N, ‖(Q x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T₁.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → (∀ x ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ σ, ‖(x - ξ) - T₁.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ≤ h₁) → ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N), (S = T ∨ S = T₁) ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin N, ‖(Q x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin N, ‖(Q x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin N, ‖(Q x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ∧ ∀ x ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ σ, ‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ≤ h₁ + Real.sqrt (4 * a / M) * σ
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof Step 1 (Simon Ch. 5, proof of 4.5, (1)–(2)). The parent applies this lemma with N := n + k, μ := R.measure, Q := approxTangentPlane n R.carrier, a := C₃δ^{2α}σⁿ, M := ω_nσⁿ/2 (density_bounds (b)), h₁ := C₃δ^α(2σ) (affine_approximation (4a)) and T₁ := T̃. Then h₁ + (4a/M)^{1/2}σ = (2C₃ + (8C₃/ω_n)^{1/2})δ^ασ = C₁₁δ^ασ, which is (2′). Notation: B := B_σ(ξ); for a subspace S' let τ_{S'}(x) := Σ_i|p_{Q(x)}e_i − p_{S'}e_i|² and J(S') := ∫⁻_B ofReal(τ_{S'}(x)) dμ.
0. Measurability. For every subspace S', x ↦ τ_{S'}(x) is μ-a.e. measurable. It is the composition of the μ-a.e. strongly measurable map x ↦ p_{Q(x)} with the continuous map L ↦ Σ_i|Le_i − p_{S'}e_i|² on continuous linear maps. Hence ofReal∘τ_{S'} is a.e.-measurable for μ restricted to B, and the lower integral is additive on such functions (lintegral_add_left′); constants pull out of lower integrals (lintegral_const_mul′).
Case 1: J(T) ≤ ofReal(a). Put S := T. Then S = T, J(S) ≤ ofReal(a) by the case assumption and J(S) ≤ J(T) trivially. It remains to prove the height bound.
1. By sibling proj_algebra (Submission.dorag_tes_projection_algebra), part (b), applied with the triple (Q(x), T, T₁), for every x: c₀ ≤ 2τ_T(x) + 2τ_{T₁}(x), where c₀ := Σ_i|p_Te_i − p_{T₁}e_i|² ≥ 0 is a constant.
2. Integrating over B with step 0: ofReal(c₀)μ(B) = ∫⁻_B ofReal(c₀) dμ ≤ ∫⁻_B (2ofReal(τ_T) + 2ofReal(τ_{T₁})) dμ = 2J(T) + 2J(T₁) ≤ 2ofReal(a) + 2ofReal(a) = ofReal(4a).
3. Since ofReal(M) ≤ μ(B) we get ofReal(c₀M) = ofReal(c₀)ofReal(M) ≤ ofReal(c₀)μ(B) ≤ ofReal(4a). As 4a ≥ 0 this means c₀M ≤ 4a, i.e. c₀ ≤ 4a/M because M > 0. Hence c₀^{1/2} ≤ (4a/M)^{1/2}.
4. Σ_i|(p_{T₁} − p_T)e_i|² = Σ_i|p_{T₁}e_i − p_Te_i|² = c₀. Let x ∈ spt μ ∩ B and y := x − ξ, so |y| ≤ σ. Then y − p_Ty = (y − p_{T₁}y) + (p_{T₁} − p_T)y. By the triangle inequality, the hypothesis on T₁, and proj_algebra (a) with A := p_{T₁} − p_T (in the form |Ay| ≤ |A||y|, the square root of (a)): |y − p_Ty| ≤ h₁ + c₀^{1/2}|y| ≤ h₁ + (4a/M)^{1/2}σ.
Case 2: J(T) > ofReal(a). Put S := T₁. Then J(S) ≤ ofReal(a) by hypothesis and J(S) ≤ ofReal(a) < J(T). For x ∈ spt μ ∩ B, |(x − ξ) − p_{T₁}(x − ξ)| ≤ h₁ ≤ h₁ + (4a/M)^{1/2}σ, since (4a/M)^{1/2} ≥ 0 and σ > 0.
The two cases are exhaustive, which proves the lemma. ∎
proof_key_steps: Case split on whether ∫_{B_σ(ξ)}|p_x − p_T|² ≤ a.
If yes, keep S = T: integrate |p_T − p_{T₁}|² ≤ 2|p_x − p_T|² + 2|p_x − p_{T₁}|² (proj_algebra (b)) and divide by μ(B_σ(ξ)) ≥ M, so |p_T − p_{T₁}|² ≤ 4a/M.
Then y − p_Ty = (y − p_{T₁}y) + (p_{T₁} − p_T)y, and proj_algebra (a) gives the height bound h₁ + (4a/M)^{1/2}σ.
If no, take S = T₁: its integral is ≤ a < the integral for T, and its height bound is h₁.

audit.reason: The ENNReal case split and measurable integral comparison give the stated plane choice and height constant. Division uses M > 0 and does not require finite ball mass. Only proj_algebra is needed.
